recognize_zh: A 圖腦部 MRI FLAIR 影像見雙側枕葉皮質下白質對稱性高訊號，典型後部可逆性腦病變症候群（PRES）；B 圖周邊血抹片有多個碎裂紅血球（schistocyte，含盔形與三角形碎片）且血小板少，代表 tacrolimus 相關血栓性微血管病變（TMA）。
features: MRI FLAIR (A): bilateral, fairly symmetric hyperintense signal in the parieto-occipital subcortical white matter and cortex
PB (B): multiple schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular fragments, and small irregular fragments
Background red cells largely normocytic with scattered microspherocyte-like dense cells
Platelets appear markedly decreased in the field
No nucleated red cells or leukemic cells seen in this field
describe_en: Axial FLAIR MRI (panel A) shows bilateral, symmetric parieto-occipital hyperintensities involving subcortical white matter and cortex, characteristic of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome. The peripheral blood smear (panel B) shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangular fragments, with a paucity of platelets in the field. There are no nucleated red cells or blasts. In a recipient of allogeneic marrow transplant on tacrolimus, findings are consistent with calcineurin inhibitor-associated PRES accompanied by transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy.

ddx.vs: TTP shows the same schistocytes and thrombocytopenia but has severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%), which is typically preserved in transplant-associated TMA.
DIC also produces schistocytes but is accompanied by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen, and markedly elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal or mild in TA-TMA.
Artifactual fragments are few and localized to thin smear edges, whereas true TMA shows reproducible schistocytes (>1%) with elevated LDH and low haptoglobin.

ddx.dx: Posterior circulation stroke or infection (e.g., PML, CNS GVHD)
ddx.vs: Posterior stroke follows a vascular territory with diffusion restriction, and PML is asymmetric without mass effect, whereas PRES is symmetric vasogenic edema that reverses after stopping tacrolimus.
